messages:
Jordan (customer): Hey team — running into streaming disconnects going through Cloudflare -> ALB. After ~60-70s idle the client gets partial output and then reconnects. Causes duplicate partial tokens billed. Ticket SF-9873. Any quick guesses?

lina: Oof. Which client version and can you share a short repro curl? Also: are you seeing HTTP 200 then a mid-stream close, or a TCP reset?

Jordan (customer): Web app, Chrome. Repro steps: 1) Start a chat, 2) idle ~70s, 3) trigger generation, 4) SSE yields a few chunks then stops, client reconnects and receives duplicate tokens. Screenshot + logs: https://example.com/sf9873/snap1.png

maria: Can you paste the raw curl output from the repro? e.g.:
```
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." https://api.redwood.example/v1/streams/abcd
```

Jordan (customer): Here's the curl result — it cuts after a chunk: 
```
data: {"id":"msg_1","delta":"Hello"}

data: {"id":"msg_1","delta":", wor"}

# nothing for ~10s then connection closed by server
```

kai: Can you share proxy logs? On our side we have a few customers hitting similar patterns when ALB idle timeout is 60s + Cloudflare origin keepalive.

Jordan (customer): Attached ALB logs in ticket.

lina: Got an nginx access/error snippet from the logs for this session: 
```
10.0.1.5 - - [17/Mar/2026:12:34:56 +0000] "GET /v1/streams/abcd HTTP/1.1" 200 0 "-" "curl/7.68.0" 
2026/03/17 12:35:16 [error] 2345#2345: *789 upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream, client: 10.0.2.10, server: api, upstream: "http://10.1.0.12:8080/stream", host: "api.redwood.example"
```

devops-bot: ALERT: ALB target-group idle timeout = 60s for prod-api (updated 2026-03-16 23:11 UTC).

maria: That error + ALB 60s smells like the ALB is tearing the connection while the app is holding the backend stream open waiting to emit more chunks. Cloudflare may be reusing TLS sessions / pooled connections and nginx is buffering, so the TCP half-close from ALB results in upstream close without the expected trailing chunk.

kai: Also check nginx proxy_buffering and gzip settings. If proxy_buffering is on we can see aggregation of small chunks into larger buffers then sudden flush/close — clients see partial output then silence.

maria: Short-term workarounds to ask the customer to try: 
- Set X-Accel-Buffering: no on their origin config (if using our nginx) or ensure proxy_buffering off
- Ensure proxy_http_version 1.1 and chunked_transfer_encoding on between proxy and app
- Increase ALB idle timeout to 300s for long-idle streams
- For Cloudflare, increase origin keepalive time or bypass CF for streaming endpoints (page rule)

lina: Also recommend client-side: implement Last-Event-ID / idempotency to avoid duplicate billing on reconnects. SSE supports last_event_id header — server can resume or ignore duplicates.

kai: Minimal nginx snippet we used in a repro env that helped: 
```
location /v1/streams/ {
  proxy_pass http://upstream;
  proxy_set_header Connection ""; # allow keepalive
  proxy_http_version 1.1;
  proxy_buffering off;
  proxy_cache off;
  chunked_transfer_encoding on;
  proxy_read_timeout 360s;
  send_timeout 360s;
  add_header X-Accel-Buffering no;
}
```

Jordan (customer): If we change ALB timeout, does that require a deploy window? We can't route around Cloudflare easily.

maria: ALB idle timeout is editable at the target-group level, no code deploy. But it affects all connections on that TG, so weigh against resource churn. For Cloudflare, you can set a page rule or use the "Bypass cache" and increase origin keepalive on the origin pool.

kai: Long-term fix tracked with eng-runtime: ensure our runtime emits periodic heartbeats (small keepalive SSE comment ':\n') every 15s and add explicit Content-Length/Transfer-Encoding semantics so middle proxies don't assume connection can be pooled. Also add detection for upstream half-close and try graceful flush + reconnect token.

eng-runtime-bot: Created ENG-1412: "sse: send periodic heartbeat + proxy-friendly headers" assigned to eng-runtime, target: 2026-03-22.

lina: For support triage: assigned SF-9873 -> eng-runtime, advised customer to try temporary nginx snippet + increase ALB idle to 300s. Also suggested client-side idempotency as protective measure for billing duplicates.

Jordan (customer): Thanks — will try ALB change and test tomorrow and report back.

maria: If you can reproduce with curl after ALB update, paste the raw output. That will confirm fixed. :thumbsup:

lina: Follow-up: patch scheduled for next week; I'll post timeline in this thread when ENG-1412 makes progress.

Jordan (customer): :thumbsup:
